label: Idealista Scraper API
title: Idealista Scraper API: Spain, Portugal, Italy & France
metaDescription: Pay per result: paste any Idealista URL (search, map area or property) and get prices, photos, contacts, GPS and features. Spain, Portugal, Italy, France.
intro: Paste any Idealista link (a property page, a search, a drawn map area or a multi-zone search) from Spain, Portugal, Italy or France and get each listing's price, photos, agency contact, GPS position and features. Large areas are collected without the usual result cap, and you pay per property returned.
useCases: Compare asking prices per m² across neighbourhoods
Send new listings in a drawn map area to a CRM or an alert
Build a sales or rental dataset for valuation models

faq.q: How is this different from Idealista Scraper?
faq.a: This one charges per property returned, also covers France, and accepts drawn-map and multi-zone links. Idealista Scraper is listed as free on the Apify Store and covers Spain, Portugal and Italy.

faq.q: Is there an official Idealista API?
faq.a: Yes, for approved partners: you apply to Idealista and use it within its limits. If you only need the listings a public search shows, this actor returns them from the link alone.

faq.q: How do businesses get property insights from Idealista?
faq.a: They collect the listings for an area (price, size, price per m², location, features) and analyze them: average price per m² by district, new listings per week, price changes over time. The table above is a real sample from the Balearic Islands.

officialApi: Idealista runs its own API for approved partners: you apply for access and work within the limits you are given. This scraper needs only a public Idealista link (search, drawn map area, multi-zone or a single property) and covers Spain, Portugal, Italy and France.

liveDemo.label: Idealista link
liveDemo.hint: Paste any Idealista search, map-area or property link (Spain, Portugal, Italy or France) and press Run: the demo fetches the first page live and shows up to 10 listings.
